close_reason: changed TrustAnchor to hold subject+SPKI (SubjectPublicKeyInfoOwned); added from_cert constructor; updated pkix-chain revocation loop to skip trust-anchor-issued cert
description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:135-146 -- TrustAnchor wraps a full Certificate. RFC 5914 defines a trust anchor as (subject name, SubjectPublicKeyInfo) -- a full self-signed certificate is not required and often not available. NSS, Windows CNG, and firmware trust stores provide just the subject DN and SPKI. Callers should not need to synthesize a Certificate to create a trust anchor. Fix: change TrustAnchor to hold subject: x509_cert::name::Name and subject_public_key_info: spki::SubjectPublicKeyInfo (owned) directly, plus a TrustAnchor::from_cert(cert: Certificate) -> Self constructor that extracts those fields. The certificate field currently pub on the struct should be removed or made private.
title: TrustAnchor requires full Certificate; should accept (subject, SPKI) directly
